client.scope: CI laboratory build, not a signed release

limits: Outer laboratory host uses KVM; nested gateway/session VMs use TCG. This does not establish production session KVM isolation.
The outer host has no network interface; no real Tor bootstrap or remote Abliteration request occurs.
The Tor guard and API/proxy credentials are synthetic. This validates offline refusal and explicit transport replacement, not a successful provider conversation over Tor.
The disk scan searches named canaries only and does not prove absence of every possible disclosure.
No PCAP is collected in this full lifecycle fixture; packet captures belong to the separate transport matrix.
Tools connector and HTTP proxy changes were added after this source and are not covered here.
Global shutdown, real USB, file transfers, live image and remaining roadmap gates are still open.
